ns2:course.label: Painting II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ARTS 251. Further develops the materials, skills, and issues introduced in that course; also considers additional painting media; explores and examines traditional and contemporary issues in painting. Prerequisite: ARTS 251.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Painting or Art Education major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $20 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
